title: 5-Day Chiang Mai Mountain Highlands & Cultural Sanctuary
description: Cool northern mountain golf in the cultural capital of Lanna. Play Chiang Mai Highlands, Alpine Chiang Mai, and Mae Jo.

signatureTour.title: The Lanna Heritage Golf Trail
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our comprehensive 7-day Lanna heritage signature tour featuring luxury private villas, temple tours, and Michelin-star dining.

featuredVenues.name: Chiang Mai Highlands Golf & Country Club

inclusions.detail: Executive chauffeured vehicles for all airport, resort, and mountain course journeys.
3 rounds: Chiang Mai Highlands, Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai, and Mae Jo Golf Resort.
4 nights in a Garden Pavilion at Four Seasons Resort Chiang Mai in the Mae Rim Valley.
Personal caddie and shared cart included for every round.
Dedicated on-ground host managing tee times and cultural dining.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Chiang Mai & Mae Rim Valley Pavilion Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Lanna Mountain Welcome
itinerary.imageCaption: Four Seasons Chiang Mai — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Four Seasons Chiang Mai luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Chiang Mai International Airport (CNX) where your private chauffeur welcomes your group and transfers you to Four Seasons Resort Chiang Mai, set among terraced rice fields in the Mae Rim Valley. Settle into your Garden Pavilion with views of the misty peaks.

Sip a welcome herbal tea on your covered outdoor sala before an authentic northern Thai dinner featuring fragrant Khao Soi curry.

itinerary.title: Mountain Foothills Gem at Chiang Mai Highlands
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Schmidt-Curley Foothills Layout
itinerary.courseName: Chiang Mai Highlands Golf & Country Club
itinerary.imageCaption: Chiang Mai Highlands Golf & Country Club — Schmidt-Curley Design (Par 72, 6,872 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Chiang Mai Highlands Golf & Country Club championship golf course Schmidt-Curley Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Chiang Mai Highlands Golf and Spa Resort, Schmidt-Curley's award-winning foothills design. Deep sand bunkers, rolling Paspalum fairways, and towering mountain ridges make this one of Thailand’s most scenic and challenging tests.

Enjoy lunch on the open-air clubhouse deck overlooking the mountain valley before returning to Four Seasons for an afternoon swim in the tiered infinity pools.

itinerary.title: Ron Garl Parkland Design at Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Asian Tour Tournament Host
itinerary.imageCaption: Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai — Ron Garl (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai championship golf course Ron Garl Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai, Ron Garl’s championship parkland layout nestled between mountain ranges. Island greens, natural streams, and pristine conditioning test every club in your bag.

Head into the historic Old City of Chiang Mai in the evening, exploring artisan night markets and sampling creative northern Thai street food.

itinerary.title: Scenic Fruit Orchards & Fairways at Mae Jo Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Championship Parkland Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Mae Jo Golf Club — Seni Thirawat (Par 72, 6,730 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Mae Jo Golf Club championship golf course Seni Thirawat Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Conclude your northern golf tour at Mae Jo Golf Resort, weaving through mature longan and lychee fruit orchards against dramatic mountain backdrops.

Gather for a tour-ending farewell dinner at Four Seasons’ acclaimed restaurant, enjoying fine wines and views of the working rice paddies.

itinerary.title: Morning Valley Coffee & VIP Airport Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Four Seasons Chiang Mai — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Four Seasons Chiang Mai luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast overlooking the misty morning valley before packing your clubs with assistance from your AGS concierge.

Your private executive transfer transports your group to Chiang Mai International Airport for your departure flight.

faqs.question: What is the climate like in Chiang Mai for golf?
faqs.answer: From November to February, Chiang Mai enjoys cool, dry weather with morning temperatures around 16-18°C, ideal for golf.
